title: custom-html widget params
description: Per-question configuration for the custom-html escape-hatch widget. ADMIN-ONLY — the teacher gallery (IW-5) must filter this kind out so only school admins can attach raw HTML to a question.

html.description: Raw HTML body the widget renders inside the sandbox. May contain inline or `src`-style `<script>` tags; the widget re-executes them in document order after innerHTML insertion. {{var}} tokens in this string are substituted server-side by the croupier (IW-3b).
